name: Swarna-Sub1 flood-tolerant rice breeding and release
description: IRRI breeders in the Philippines bred versions of the Indian rice cultivar Swarna with a temporary-submergence tolerance trait from the FR13A-derived line IR49830-7-1-2-3. India’s Central Rice Research Institute evaluated a line with farmers, and Odisha released it for lowland cultivation in 2009. Farm surveys documented cultivation in 2015. The released Odisha line IR05F101 and the sister line IR05F102 share the Swarna-Sub1 name.

places.note: Odisha selection and release; evaluated in field studies of eastern India.

events.statement: The breeding team reported temporary-submergence tolerance in Swarna-Sub1 lines derived from the FR13A descendant IR49830-7-1-2-3.
events.place_note: Research at the International Rice Research Institute, Philippines.

evidence.supports: Figure 3 shows two experimental Swarna-Sub1 lines, including IR82810-407.
Identifies IR82810-407 as the line designated IR05F102 and distinguishes the later-released line IR05F101.

date.basis: The coordinating centre's trial table gives 2007.

events.statement: The Central Rice Research Institute’s line CR2539-1 (IET 20266, IR82809-237) was entered in the Initial Variety Trial-Late.

evidence.supports: The table identifies CR2539-1 / IET 20266 and the 2007 trial; the release section confirms IR82809-237 was the same line.

date.label: 20 April 2009
date.basis: Meeting date stated in the contemporary CRRI newsletter.

events.statement: The Orissa State Seed Sub-Committee released Swarna-Sub1 (CR 2539-1, IET 20266) for shallow coastal lowlands.

evidence.supports: Records state release and intended cultivation area after testing in farmers’ fields.
Confirms the release and identifies the genotype as IR82809-237.

date.label: 26 June 2009
date.basis: Date of the central subcommittee's 53rd meeting in the contemporary CRRI newsletter.

events.statement: The central crop-variety subcommittee approved Swarna-Sub1 for notification.

evidence.supports: Reports approval for notification, separately from the state-level release.

date.label: 2011 kharif
date.basis: The original paper examines the 2011 growing season and floods.

events.statement: A randomized field trial in 128 Odisha villages found a yield benefit for Swarna-Sub1 under temporary submergence.
events.caveats: Experimenters provided seed to participants. Trial participation does not estimate ordinary adoption.

evidence.supports: The original experiment estimated a positive yield effect when fields were submerged for 7–14 days.

date.label: 2015 kharif
date.basis: The survey was conducted after the 2015 wet-season harvest and asked about cultivation that season.

events.statement: A post-harvest survey found Swarna-Sub1 cultivation among sampled rice-farming households in Odisha and West Bengal.
events.place_note: Sampled flood-prone districts of Odisha and West Bengal.
events.population: Rice-farming households in sampled villages in flood-prone districts.
events.caveats: These percentages describe the survey sample.

evidence.supports: Gives geographic scope and dates the crop being reported.
Reports cultivation among 16.7% of sampled Odisha households and 4.2% of sampled West Bengal households.

date.label: August 2026
date.basis: The project's 4 September report describes the August flood episode and names deployment already underway.

events.statement: During the August flood episode, UPSCALE documented Swarna Sub1 in a monitored farmer-led deployment in Rajkanika block. The project listed 85 farmers in 10 villages across 34 hectares.
events.caveats: Project footprint only. The report gives no variety-specific survival, harvest, or persistence after the flood.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning “Odisha” and the Rajkanika block variety table
evidence.supports: Project field report gives timing and Swarna Sub1 row.
Documents earlier seed distribution and monitoring of farmer-led field demonstrations.

earliest_record.rationale: The 2006 original report describes the Swarna-Sub1 development and a named line from this family. The exact later Odisha release line is separately attested in the 2007 trial.

links.statement: IR49830-7-1-2-3 supplied the inherited Sub1 tolerance trait to the Swarna-Sub1 breeding programme.
links.scope: The actual donor was line -3. The 1990–1991 result concerns another member of the IR49830 family, line -2.

evidence.supports: Original experimental report names the -3 donor and documents its contribution.
The contemporary Indian partner identifies the same donor for the Odisha release line.
The Cuttack coordinating centre's trial register confirms the donor for the exact release genotype.

unresolved.note: Locate the central notification itself and distinguish any national gazette date from the April 2009 state release and June approval.
A later independent probability sample and the 2026 Rajkanika variety-specific harvest would establish uptake and flood outcomes beyond the reported project footprint.
